title: Backporting quarterly doc reviews: skip sections for features absent in the target release
answers: How to backport a quarterly docs review PR when the automatic backport has conflicts
Backport hit merge conflicts on datasource docs, what to keep
Manual backport process for docs quarterly update
body:
When a quarterly docs-review PR is backported to an older release branch and the automatic backport conflicts, resolve manually per-file: keep content describing features that don't exist in that release (e.g. "Enable Batch API" section was omitted for the 13.1 branch), while still applying release_date/terminology fixes that are release-independent.
Apply the `review_date` bump and any terminology fixes (e.g. self-hosted → self-managed) across all touched pages regardless of which branch, since those aren't feature-gated.
Constraints: verify feature existence in the target release before porting new functional sections (like a new toggle or limit); don't assume a docs change that applies cleanly to `main` is safe to port verbatim to a release branch.
applies: Manual backport docs PRs to release-x.y branches under docs/sources/datasources/**
